seo.title: Drinks & Mojitos Pizza Menu in Upton | Bar 7
seo.description: Browse drinks at Bar 7 pub in Upton upon Severn and order Mojitos pizza, salads and sides for delivery to your table with no added fee.

intro.heading: Drinks at Bar 7
intro.text: Bar 7 serves drinks and a small selection of bar snacks. Jump to the Mojitos menu below for pizzas, salads and sides.

food.heading: Mojitos Pizza Menu
food.intro: Order at the Bar 7 bar and Mojitos, just down the road, will deliver your food to your table here at Bar 7.
food.payment: Pay by cash or card — no added delivery fee.
food.disclaimer: Prices shown on this website may not always reflect the current price. We make every effort to keep the site updated, but please verify prices with a member of staff before ordering.
food.note: Gluten-free pizza bases are available on request (10-inch only).
